takes.line: d|amy|The Gregori Rule. No throwing at teachers. It's still on the wall.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, formal] The Gregori Rule. No throwing at teachers. [smug, fond] It's still on the wall.

takes.line: d|amy|The footprints go in there. The sign-up sheet is in there.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, tense, low] The footprints go in [emphasis] there. [determined, firm] The sign-up sheet must be in there.

takes.line: d|amy|That's the conference sign-up sheet. Thirty parents are waiting for it.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, stern, matter of fact] That's the conference sign-up sheet. [urging] Thirty parents are waiting for it.

takes.line: d|amy|Up. Everybody. Walk it off.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, brisk, rallying] Up! Everybody! [calm] Walk it off.

takes.line: d|amy|...I'm taking it. Thank you.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, grabbing urgently] ...I'm taking it. [warm, sincere] Thank you.

takes.line: d|amy|Oh. A text. From Justin.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, soft, surprised] Oh. A text. [warm, pleased] From Justin.

takes.line: d|amy|"Heard it went great. Proud of you. Stuck at work till nine. Save me a cookie." With a little heart.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, warm, even] "Heard it went great. Proud of you. [rueful, fond] Stuck at work till nine. Save me some casserole." [softening, tender] With a little heart.

takes.line: d|amy|"Heard it went great. Proud of you. Stuck at work till nine. Save me a cookie." With a little heart.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, warm, even] "Heard it went great. Proud of you. [rueful, fond] Stuck at work till nine. Save me some casserole."

takes.line: d|amy|Girls. Did we save a cookie for Dad?
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, pointed, mock stern] Girls. [teasing, knowing] Did we save some casserole for Daddy?

takes.line: d|amy|Everybody in the van. Tom, you too. You were the good uncle tonight. By a lot.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, brisk, warm] Everybody in the van. Tom, you too. [sincere, affectionate] You were a good uncle tonight. [emphatic, fond] By a lot.

takes.line: d|amy|Rose, shoes. Grace, water. Tom, posture.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, brisk, clipped] Rose, shoes. Grace, water. [pointed, commanding] Tom, posture.

takes.line: d|deedee|Here. Cookies for the flight. To the moon and back, honey.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [warm, bustling] Here. Cookies for the flight. [tender, loving] To the moon and back, honey.

takes.line: d|deedee|Oh, Tommy. Somebody has to stay with my angels. And the pies.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [warm, fussing] Oh, Tommy. Somebody has to stay with my girls. [sweet, firm] And the pies.
